entries.contract: typed scalar predicates; nullable Boolean; preserves rows
entries.notes: Use symbolic operators, not Python truthiness.

entries.contract: Boolean expression; conservative nullability; preserves rows
entries.notes: Null and NaN stay distinct.

entries.contract: typed numeric expression; preserves rows
entries.notes: Operand types determine the result type.

entries.contract: integer/long expressions; mixed pair returns long; input nullability propagates; preserves rows
entries.notes: Typed methods avoid Python's ambiguous & and | operators, which remain Boolean composition.

entries.structure: contains(...), startswith(...), endswith(...), like(...), ilike(...), rlike(...)
entries.contract: Boolean expression; input nullability propagates; preserves rows
entries.notes: Plain, case-insensitive, regex, prefix, and suffix matching remain compiler-visible.

entries.contract: declared scalar result; try_cast nullable; preserves rows
entries.notes: try_cast is capability checked.

entries.contract: typed struct/array/map selection; lookup nullable; preserves rows
entries.notes: Physical aliases remain schema-owned.

entries.contract: exact declared Struct result; preserves rows
entries.notes: The declared result Schema must preserve the source shape except for the named replacement or removals.

entries.contract: sort-key descriptor; preserves rows
entries.notes: Used by typed windows and admitted ordered operations.

entries.contract: schema constructors own names
entries.notes: Use Schema fields and aliases rather than Column alias().

entries.contract: compiler-visible Window contract
entries.notes: Raw WindowSpec is an explicit hook boundary.

entries.structure: when(...), coalesce(...), nvl(...), ifnull(...), nvl2(...), nullif(...), zeroifnull(...)
entries.contract: typed scalar result; preserves rows
entries.notes: Fallback and branch nullability are analyzed symbolically; nullif remains nullable because a match becomes null.

entries.contract: Boolean/scalar expression; preserves rows
entries.notes: Null and NaN remain distinct; nanvl replaces only NaN values.

entries.contract: typed String or scalar result; preserves rows
entries.notes: The practical String helper set is supported with compiler-visible literal options.

entries.contract: typed numeric result; preserves rows
entries.notes: Rounding preserves numeric precision rules; transcendental and sign helpers return Double values.

entries.structure: typed date arithmetic, truncation, extraction, and conversion helpers
entries.contract: typed date, timestamp, or integer result; preserves rows
entries.notes: Date parsing is nullable; literal formats and truncation units remain compiler-visible.

entries.structure: typed scalar hashes and String digests
entries.contract: hashes accept scalar expressions and preserve nullability; String digests preserve String nullability
entries.notes: Hash output is not a cryptographic or cross-engine identity contract. String digests are not password-storage primitives.

entries.contract: Binary input/output requires a public Binary Structure type
entries.notes: Deferred: Structure intentionally has no binary type, so base64/unbase64/encode/decode cannot retain an exact typed contract. Use @raw until a binary-type design is approved.

entries.contract: Schema arguments and normalized options need a reusable inline-schema IR contract
entries.notes: Deferred: JSON/CSV conversion needs an inline Schema transport and stable option normalization in both generated and online paths. Use @raw until that typed parser contract is approved.

entries.structure: array(...), array_repeat(...), sequence(...), and typed mutation helpers
entries.contract: typed array result; preserves rows
entries.notes: sequence supports Integer/Long values; arr_insert positions and arr_remove values stay literal for the PySpark 3.5 baseline.

entries.structure: size(...), array_contains(...), arr_position(...), element_at(...), try_element_at(...), slice(...)
entries.contract: typed scalar/nullable lookup; preserves rows
entries.notes: Array indices are one-based; slice rejects negative literal lengths.

entries.contract: typed array/scalar result; preserves rows
entries.notes: Sort accepts orderable scalar elements; callbacks remain symbolic.

entries.contract: typed map/scalar result; preserves rows
entries.notes: Map callbacks stay symbolic.

entries.structure: posexplode_struct(...), explode_struct(...); @raw hook for remaining generator variants
entries.contract: row expansion requires a declared generated scope schema and cardinality model
entries.notes: The admitted generators are posexplode_struct(...) and explode_struct(...) over array<struct> with contains_null=False. Outer generator forms and inline remain deferred until their distinct schemas and null/empty semantics are implemented.

entries.contract: declared schema; preserves or filters rows
entries.notes: Schema constructors own column replacement and names.

entries.structure: rowset_join(...), inner_join(...), exists(...), relation_alias(...), join hints
entries.contract: explicit join cardinality and schema; may multiply rows
entries.notes: Cross joins require allow_cartesian=True. Self joins require named relation aliases.

entries.structure: union_all(...), union_by_name(...), intersect(...), intersect_all(...), subtract(...), except_all(...); @raw hook for missing-column union
entries.contract: Exact-schema relation set composition uses Spark duplicate/distinct semantics and makes no ordering claim
entries.notes: The admitted v6 set operations combine the active rowset with an unjoined exact-schema relation, including independently materialized typed lanes. Missing-column union remains deferred until its schema-evolution and nullability policy is specified.

entries.contract: reduces rows; watermark variant is streaming-classified
entries.notes: Key semantics are explicit.

entries.structure: order_by(...), limit(...), offset(...); @raw hook for sample
entries.contract: Relation ordering uses typed order descriptors; literal limit/offset bounds require the current relation state to be ordered
entries.notes: Order is observable at materialized output boundaries. Set, join, generator, aggregate, and selected-row operations break the current ordered-state claim unless followed by another order_by(...). Sampling remains deferred until seed, replacement, and reproducibility semantics are specified.

entries.contract: Declared business keys, eligibility predicate, and priority order select at most one row per key
entries.notes: Configured missing or tied candidates fail with REL-E0705. Keys must be declared field references; surrogate row identifiers remain unsupported.

entries.contract: aggregate cardinality; declared output schema
entries.notes: Post-aggregate filtering uses having(...).

entries.contract: aggregate scalar result; declared output schema
entries.notes: Dictionary aggregate syntax is intentionally unsupported.

entries.structure: approx_percentile(...), percentile(...), and typed statistics; @raw for mode
entries.contract: aggregate result; declared output schema
entries.notes: Deterministic mode is deferred: its tie-break parameter is unavailable in PySpark 3.5. Use @raw for mode until the baseline can state a deterministic contract.

entries.structure: typed ranking, selection, and aggregate window helpers
entries.contract: preserves rows; typed window result
entries.notes: Raw WindowSpec remains outside the DSL.

entries.contract: adds streaming state metadata; preserves rows
entries.notes: Caller retains lifecycle ownership.

entries.contract: typed TimeWindow grouping key; aggregate cardinality
entries.notes: The gap is a positive fixed Spark interval; the result is a TimeWindow Struct grouping key.
